subject.title: feat(cron): unattended-run preamble and watcher-authoring guidance

question: Should OpenClaw make this unattended-execution contract the default prompt policy for all isolated cron jobs and external-hook runs?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally static and compatibility-conscious, but it changes how existing scheduled agents are instructed to respond; this default policy choice cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt after live proof
options.body: Accept the default contract after the contributor supplies redacted real cron and external-hook evidence showing final-deliverable behavior and preserved delivery semantics.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Limit the guidance to a defined subset of cron jobs if maintainers do not want it to affect every isolated or hook-triggered run.

options.title: Defer to cron unification
options.body: Close or pause this implementation until the broader automation design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/110950 establishes the permanent prompt policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the default contract after the contributor supplies redacted real cron and external-hook evidence showing final-deliverable behavior and preserved delivery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the implementation and the linked automation-direction proposal.
